+## #1864 - 2D Contour on DXF sketches: layer/chain picking, per-chain overrides, and sketch verify
+
+Maintainer request from #1452 ("We should be able to load DXF file to do profile cuts on."), continuing #1862 and #1863.
+
+### What was decided and why
+
+- **Extend `FeatureSel` with `SketchChain(ChainId)` and `SketchLayer(String)` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs`).**
+  `FeatureSel` drops `Copy` and derives `Clone` so `SketchLayer` can carry the layer name directly across UI state, commands, MCP IDs (`sketch_chain:<hex>` / `sketch_layer:<name>`), and `PROJECT_VERSION = 73` (`crates/app/src/project/file.rs`).
+  - *Dropped*: interning DXF layer names into numeric IDs or resolving layers into fixed chain lists at pick time. Expanding a layer pick dynamically during resolution (`crates/app/src/operation/contour_sketch_pick.rs`) keeps layer picks accurate when a DXF sketch is reloaded.
+- **Additive per-chain overrides on `OpParams::Contour` (`ChainOverride` in `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs` and `crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs`).**
+  Each override keys on `(entity, chain: ChainId)` with optional `side: Option<ChainSide>` and `reverse: bool` (`#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]`). `PROJECT_VERSION` steps from `72` to `73` so older builds refuse files carrying sketch picks or per-chain overrides instead of silently dropping them, while v72 files load unchanged.
+  - *Dropped*: attaching `side`/`reverse` onto `GeoSel` itself (which would break layer picks and prevent plain selection equality) or minting a separate sketch-only operation variant. Storing `chain_overrides` on `OpParams::Contour` reuses the standard `EditOperationParams` undo/redo and `GenStamp` staleness checks, while `SetOperationGeometry::with_chain_overrides` lets MCP callers update picks and overrides in one undo step.
+- **Natural nesting when uniform, ordered per-chain generation when overridden (`crates/app/src/operation/contour_sketch.rs`).**
+  Whole sketches (`SrcRef::Entity`) and layer/chain picks with unmodified `Auto` sides and uniform `climb` check `can_group_natural` and cut as one nested `Region` (holes Inside, outers Outside). When per-chain `side` or `reverse` overrides diverge, closed chains generate in hole-before-outer order so inner bores clear while the part still holds them. Preserved closed polylines and sampled arcs keep true CL `ArcMove` geometry so `posting` emits `G2`/`G3`.
+- **Explicit open-chain safety (`validate_plan` in `crates/app/src/operation/contour_sketch.rs`).**
+  Open DXF chains cut along the centerline only. Operation-level `Side::Inside`/`Side::Outside`, any per-chain `ChainSide` override on an open chain, and control/wear compensation (`G41`/`G42`) refuse by name, naming the sketch chain; `reverse: true` remains allowed to flip centerline direction.
+  - *Dropped*: guessing an inside/outside side from winding or open endpoints, which causes silent undercuts or wrong compensation.
+- **Meshless generation and verification (`crates/app/src/sketch_model.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/material.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`).**
+  `sketch_model::generation_problem` admits `OpParams::Contour`, and `material::named_material` returns the placed sketch stock-top height with empty facets for `Sketch` entities (`part_solid = false`). Unresolved `TopOfModel`/`BottomOfModel` heights still refuse via `sketch_model::NO_SOLID_HEIGHT`. Stock removal (`stock_sim::simulate_document`), crossing, stock-rapid, and fixture collision checks run against setup stock and fixtures without requiring a 3D solid mesh.
+- **Ray-to-curve picking and UI workflow (`crates/app/src/pick/sketch_pick.rs`, `crates/ui/src/edge_pick.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs`).**
+  `pick_feature` projects sketch primitives at their setup pose, finds the closest curve within pick radius, and respects front solid occlusion unless `PickQuery::through` is set. `edge_pick` appends Shift-clicked `SketchChain` picks instead of running 3D loop extension, `geo_page` adds per-layer toggle buttons, `mill2d_page`/`fields.rs` edits `Per-chain overrides`, and `pick_highlight`/`interact` render hovered and selected sketch chains in world space.
+
+### What it costs to change later
+
+- A future sketch operation kind (such as `2D Pocket` on DXF profiles) can reuse `SketchContourPlan` resolution in `contour_sketch_pick.rs` and `named_material` stock-top handling while adding its own clearing generator and `sketch_model::generation_problem` arm.
+- Adding per-chain lead or tab overrides on top of `ChainOverride` requires adding defaulted fields to `ChainOverrideDto` and another `PROJECT_VERSION` bump.

+## #1868 - Slot and Trochoidal Slot on DXF sketch chains
+
+**What was decided**
+
+- A Slot and a Trochoidal Slot read one picked chain of a DXF profile.
+  They keep their two points and their width (`a`, `b`, `width`). The
+  project file does not change, and no version bump is necessary.
+- The pick seeds the numbers in the pick's own command
+  (`CreateOperation`, `SetOperationGeometry`). One undo takes back the pick
+  and the seed. This is the law that #1504 made for model picks.
+  - One closed line-arc slot outline seeds `a`, `b` and `width`.
+  - One open straight chain is the centerline. It seeds `a` and `b`. The
+    typed `width` stays.
+- Generation judges the stored slot against the picked chain, as the world
+  is at that time. A slot that left its outline, or whose ends are not the
+  ends of its centerline, is refused by name. A moved or re-imported
+  profile cannot cut in the old position.
+- A closed chain is a slot outline only when the fitted straight slot
+  covers 99.5 % or more of the area of the chain. A rectangle, a circle, an
+  L or a keyhole is refused by name.
+- A selection with more than one chain is refused by name. The whole
+  profile as the source is refused by name.
+- The refusal of a Slot that is narrower than the tool now gives the two
+  numbers.
+
+**Why**
+
+- The room law of `machining2d::SlotBound` (#1504) is reviewed and pinned.
+  A sketch outline is a face room, and the existing fit and confine laws
+  apply without a second algorithm. A centerline is one new room kind
+  (`Room::Line`) with a small law of its own.
+- Seeded numbers stay visible and editable on the operation page. The
+  generator, the machine area, the WCS rotation and the verification read
+  `a`, `b` and `width` in many places. A second source of slot geometry in
+  the job would need a change in each of them, in safety code.
+- The stock simulation and the verification use the setup stock
+  (`part_solid = false`), as #1864 made for the 2D Contour.
+- The area test refuses an outline that only contains a slot. The model
+  face law of #1504 accepts a rectangular floor as a room, because a floor
+  face is the room of a slot. A drawn outline is the slot itself, so the
+  rule is stricter.
+
+**Considered and dropped**
+
+- Bent and arc centerlines (an open chain of lines and arcs). The plain
+  Slot generator cuts a straight channel only. The Trochoidal Slot
+  generator takes a point chain, but its machine area, its fit law and its
+  parameters have two points. A curved channel needs a new parameter form
+  and a new machine area. Such a chain is refused by name. This needs an
+  issue of its own.
+- Closed chains as centerlines (a circular groove). A closed chain is read
+  as an outline only. One chain cannot be the two things without a new
+  parameter, and a wrong guess cuts in the wrong place.
+- More than one chain in one operation (a layer of slots). The operation
+  holds one `a`, `b` and `width`. Each slot is one operation for now.
+- New `SrcRef` or `OpParams` fields for the sketch. The existing
+  `SrcRef::Selection` with `FeatureSel::SketchChain` / `SketchLayer` of
+  #1864 holds all that is necessary.
+- An analytic read of the outline (two lines and two half circles from the
+  chain segments). The area test accepts the same outlines, and it also
+  accepts an outline whose arcs a CAD system wrote as short lines.
+
+**Cost to change later**
+
+- Curved centerlines add a parameter form. That is a project file change
+  with a version bump.
+- The 99.5 % limit is one constant (`OUTLINE_COVER` in
+  `operation/slot_sketch.rs`).
+- The messages of a judged sketch outline say "the picked face" (the text
+  of the face room). A separate room name is a small change in
+  `slot_room.rs`, which is near the 400-line limit.
